Grab your FREE Central TX Relocation Guide and start planning your move with confidence:  🔗 https://bit.ly/3DWFw7V
----------
In this video, we'll walk you through Stinnett Mill in Salado TX, a brand new construction community with half acre lots, mature oak trees, and stunning 4 bedroom floor plans starting in the low $700s. You’ll see the Reagan floor plan and Clinton floor plan, both showcasing open concept living rooms with tall ceilings, designer lighting, quartz countertops with gold veining, custom cabinetry, three car garages, and spa-like primary suites with massive walk-in closets. If you’ve been searching for luxury homes near Fort Cavazos, new construction homes near Temple and Belton, or an upscale golf course community in Salado Texas with easy access to Austin, Georgetown, Waco, and major Central Texas employers, this is the perfect deep dive into what high-end, energy-efficient new construction really looks like!

If you’d like to see this Stinnett Mill home in person, walk a few of the floor plans, or you have questions about building or buying in Salado or anywhere in Central Texas, reach out to me today and I’ll help you schedule a private tour and walk you through every step of the new construction process! 🏡
